# v2026.10.47

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.47.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.47.md).

This release covers **13 pull requests, with thanks to 1 contributor.**

## Highlights

- Send holds drafts that a skip rule matches, and you can delete a draft that was never issued. ([#316](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/316)) Thanks [@cursoragent](https://github.com/cursoragent).
- Bulk Send continues when one job cannot be confirmed. ([#313](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/313)) Thanks [@cursoragent](https://github.com/cursoragent).
- Send to Xero shows that it is working, then opens the tab the invoices went to. ([#309](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/309))
- The Invoices filter stays on screen and offers the list's fields. ([#314](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/314)) Thanks [@cursoragent](https://github.com/cursoragent).
- Each person can pin pages in the sidebar, and the More menu floats over the page. ([#304](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/304)) Thanks [@cursoragent](https://github.com/cursoragent).
- A problem report carries a replay of the minute before it. ([#320](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/320))

## Changes

- Each person can pin pages in the sidebar, and the More menu floats over the page. ([#304](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/304)) Thanks [@cursoragent](https://github.com/cursoragent).
- A problem report carries a replay of the minute before it. ([#320](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/320))
- Each design system card lists its phone rules. ([#302](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/302)) Thanks [@cursoragent](https://github.com/cursoragent).
- Each release gets a docs-site page and a thanks roster after the docs deploy. ([#274](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/274)) Thanks [@cursoragent](https://github.com/cursoragent).

## Fixes

- Send holds drafts that a skip rule matches, and you can delete a draft that was never issued. ([#316](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/316)) Thanks [@cursoragent](https://github.com/cursoragent).
- Bulk Send continues when one job cannot be confirmed. ([#313](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/313)) Thanks [@cursoragent](https://github.com/cursoragent).
- Send to Xero shows that it is working, then opens the tab the invoices went to. ([#309](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/309))
- The Invoices filter stays on screen and offers the list's fields. ([#314](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/314)) Thanks [@cursoragent](https://github.com/cursoragent).
